observations: body L1: the figure 7 of «700 milliariorum» is printed with a break in its stroke.

body L5, L9-L10, L24-L25, L28-L29, L34-L35, L39: the Arabic quotations stand in the Latin lines and are set right to left; a quotation that runs over into the next line begins at the right margin and goes on in the next line from the right end of its Arabic words, after which the Latin text follows. The edition gives every part in reading order.

body L28, L34: the reading of the manuscripts «(طرف codd.)» stands at the left of «الى طرفه», that is after it in the right-to-left order of the quotation, and in the same way the word added by the editor, «[يُعْرَف add.]», stands after «وطَرَفه»; read from left to right, codd. and add. stand before the Arabic word. The edition keeps both in their place in the Arabic run.
body L34-L35, L39: the quotation of Quṭb ad-dīn ash-Shīrāzī and the second quotation of Qāḍī-zādeh are printed without the parentheses that enclose the other Arabic quotations of the page.
body L5, L29: the final yā' is printed with its dots in «اعني» and «الذي» and in «مائتي», without them in «الادنى» and «يسمى»; transcribed as printed.
body L24: before «وعرض طرفيه» and after «طرفيه مائتا» spacing material that rose in the forme has printed black marks above and below the line; they are not signs.
body L25, L37: the kāf of «اكـــــبر» is printed in its lengthened form, and the connection of «عنــد» is drawn out; the edition lengthens both with tatweels to about the printed length.
body L17: the l of «l’Atlantique que le nom» is printed broken, its upper part standing like the dot of an i.
body L26: small specks stand under the l of «verba igitur al–Mas‘ūdī» and under the B of «cum al–Battānī»; they are not signs.
body L27: «cod P» is printed without the full stop of the abbreviation; kept as printed.
body L32: a speck stands over the second u of «cuius extremitas»; it is not an accent.
body L31-L34, L37-L38: the conversions in brackets reckon three miles to the parasang (200 = 600, 460 = 1380, 60 = 180); computed again, all are correct.
body L1-L42: the lines that hold Arabic words stand further apart than the others (up to about 15.5 pt against 13.9 pt); the edition follows the measured spacing.
body L5-L7: on the readings «طرفه» and «طريقه», «الاخير» and «الاخضر», see de Goeje's letter in Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (pp. XXIII-XXIV), recorded on p. 177 (L12-L25).
body L10: de Goeje's later view of his note on Qodāmah, in a letter that Nallino gives in his addenda et emendanda in Part II (p. XXIII), is recorded on p. 177 (L12-L25).

body L28: de Goeje, in a letter given in Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (p. XXIV), reads «الطرف» for the «الى طرف» of al-Kharaqī's text and would supply Ibn Rosteh's اعني; recorded on p. 177 (L12-L25).
notes_left, notes_right: the rule over the notes is printed faintly and only in fragments; a thin vertical rule stands between the two columns of notes.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
